observed: The original 12-block radius and 12-block depth stopped searching early. A 64-block radius and 32-block depth were live-tested with near-to-far scanning.
Empty dives occurred because the controller required several ascent samples before allowing any mining. A first-dive equipment estimate now permits work under a conservative live air reserve.

A selected gravel column could be abandoned after flight momentum carried the player into a neighboring column. Target coordinates are preserved, exact-column checks are bounded, and unreachable targets are skipped.
At one pickup, air policy changed during descent and rejected the action. The pending mined block is kept while surfacing, then rechecked after refilling.

Water current moved item drops beyond the old 1.5-block pickup limit. A nearby clear return column can now trigger at most two surface recenter attempts. A 1.9.96 live run logged a recenter attempt and finished with four items credited against a target of three.

validation.live_batch: 4 confirmed inventory gravel on a 3-item target, no player damage, safe high park
validation.live_limit: One drifting item was not confirmed on its first recenter; a later pickup gained two items. This is not proof of long-term unattended collection.

safety_rule: Expected air duration from oxygen_bonus is a mean, not a guarantee. Native ascent, current air, route clearance, combat and low-health guards retain priority.
